mission_definition.fast: minimize decision time subject to stability and CE budgets
mission_definition.stable: minimize stability cost subject to time and CE budgets
mission_definition.efficient: minimize CE subject to time and stability budgets

budget_generation: exact critical values observed among good candidates in each paired context; no manually chosen global thresholds
candidate_scope: all feasible Pareto-nondominated good trajectories; expressibility is checked only after mission selection
important_note: These are synthetic counterfactual mission decisions for controlled validation. They are not claimed to be human expert preference demonstrations.
